description: "The Road Not Taken" by Robert Frost is a poem about a traveler faced with making a difficult decision in life. The traveler must decide which of two roads to take, both of which appear equally worn and equally inviting. The traveler eventually takes the less-traveled road because it holds more potential and offers more opportunities.
